names.why: About 19 of 28 videos are sky rather than sunshine: sunrise, sunset, dusk, moon, stars, clouds, dark, vapour trails, a red night glow. Moon and stars under 'Sunshine' is a visible mismatch; 'Sky' covers them and the sun. The heat and season videos (heat, hot, summer, heat wave, autumn, spring, fall) are loose under either name.

notes: No clear misplacement. 6826 'air' is a light breeze, so not Storm.
